tools.name: search_registry
tools.description: Search verified family offices and related firms in Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Austria, Germany, Dubai (free, no names) and the US (registered advisers). Returns one page of open records — the same fields the public site publishes. Named people, contact channels, source lists and verification notes

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: One firm by its registry id. Without a subscription key this returns the open fields and says how many named roles the full record holds; with one it returns the named roles, the contact channels, the full source list and the verification note.
